title: Data Center Is Fined $1.1 Million for Operating 62 Power Generators

reports.title: Data Center Is Fined $1.1 Million for Operating 62 Power Generators

summary:
New Jersey fined DataOne $1.07 million on Tuesday for operating 62 natural gas generators without permits at its Vineland data center site. State inspectors found the 2,000-kilowatt generators in late July. Each was about the size of a tractor-trailer, and none had the required permits to be installed or operated. Officials said the penalty for violating the Air Pollution Control Act is the largest ever issued to a data center operator in New Jersey.

The planned 2.6 million-square-foot campus is due for completion at the end of the year and will need 350 megawatts, enough for a medium-size city. Some of it is already in use. Homeowners have filed a federal lawsuit over persistent noise, and the Cumberland County Health Department has issued DataOne violation orders for excessive noise. Governor Mikie Sherrill said at a Climate Week event that data center development should benefit New Jersey communities.
